caption: The drawing features a rectangular central text box bordered by a decorative frame of leaves, thistles, and birds. The leaves are predominantly shades of brown, red, and rust, with curling and twisting shapes, while the thistles are blue-green with spiky purple tips. Scattered throughout the border are several birds, all white with gray-blue shading and black-tipped wings, depicted in various flying orientations. The inner text is written in blackletter script, with some words in blue, red, or gold for emphasis. A gold branch with olive-green leaves stretches horizontally beneath the top part of the text. In the lower portion, there is a large illuminated letter "T" decorated with intricate patterns and containing a small illustration of a man on a boat or by water, with a partly cloudy sky and landscape elements in the background. The overall composition is symmetrical, with the decorative natural elements intertwining around the central text in a balanced arrangement. The background of the border is a muted golden brown, providing contrast to the more vibrant colors of the leaves, thistles, and birds.
title: Illuminated Parable: The Sower
